messages:
Priya Nair: Heads up — Starlit Analytics is going into APAC pilot tomorrow morning and asked for a short-term egress allowlist + rate bump so their demo traffic doesn't hit throttles. They're at 90% of their allocated seats and renewal conversation depends on a smooth pilot. Can infra help with a temporary exception (12h) for a handful of CIDRs + a QPS bump to 120?

Kai Zhang: Copy. Can you paste the CIDRs and preferred time window? I need to check peering and any existing peering rules.

Priya Nair: Thanks Kai. CIDRs below, window: 2024-10-09 01:00-13:00 UTC (12h). Auto-revoke after window.

```json
{
  "customer": "Starlit Analytics",
  "cidrs": ["203.119.6.0/24", "43.250.12.128/25"],
  "region": "ap-southeast-1",
  "qps_target": "120",
  "reason": "pilot demo for renewal decision",
  "auto_revoke": "2024-10-09T13:00:00Z"
}
```

Jon Baxter: tagging infra-bot to create a temporary rule and generate a PR for audit. infra-bot do you have bandwidth for a quick preflight?

infra-bot: @Jon Baxter received. Opening temporary egress request ID ST-20241009-11. Preflight checks: peering status OK, no known conflicting CIDRs. ETA ~14m to apply and post audit link. :gear: 

Kai Zhang: I ran a quick safety check. Two notes: 1) second CIDR overlaps a customer-owned /24 in our allowlist table — will whitelist the /25 as requested but flag it in the audit. 2) Because the demo will generate long prompt chains, recommend enabling prefix KV caching for this customer route to keep latency stable under the higher QPS.

Marta Lopez: Priya — please confirm that Starlit agrees to the auto-revoke and the audit log being shared with their security contact. Renewal team wants to reference the demo metrics.

Priya Nair: Confirmed with Starlit sec point-of-contact (sec@starlit.ai). They agreed to auto-revoke and sharing audit. Also asked if we can bump burst window to 200 for 30 mins at 05:00 UTC during the run. Is that doable?

Kai Zhang: 30-min burst to 200 QPS is fine as long as it's timeboxed and part of the temp rule. I'll include both the steady QPS (120) and the burst policy in the PR.

infra-bot: Temporary rule ST-20241009-11 applied to route starlit-prod-apac. Audit PR: https://rwd-infra/pulls/8123 — contains CIDR whitelist, QPS steady=120, burst={"limit":200,"duration":"30m"}, auto-revoke timestamp.

Priya Nair: Awesome, thanks team. I'll share the audit link with the customer and schedule a post-mortem metric dump for Marta. :raised_hands: 

Marta Lopez: Please capture token-level cost and 95th p95 latency for the demo window. That will help the renewal deck.

Kai Zhang: Noted. I'll also attach a short note recommending prefix caching and the runtime config we used so they can reproduce.

Priya Nair: Closing loop — if infra confirms the revoke went through after the window, I'll mark this as green for the renewal tracker. Thanks everyone. :white_check_mark: 

infra-bot: Auto-revoke scheduled. Will post confirmation after 2024-10-09T13:05:00Z.
